title: ControlIdentity
description: Reader-UI 交互控件稳定身份契约（A0 · 全局控制面纠偏版，schema 1.3.0）。三层身份模型：(1) entityKey 是逻辑控件实体 {domain}.{family}.{role}[.{actionKey}]，actionKey 只能来自显式语义属性白名单（data-action / data-route / data-route-back 等），无显式语义时 entityKey = {domain}.{family}.{role} 且 needsActionKey=true；(2) controlKey 是逻辑控件在某 route/state 的出现 {entityKey}@{route}.{state}[.{instanceKey}]，instanceKey 来自显式实例标识属性（data-book-id / data-reader-tts-timer-value 等），同 (route, state, entityKey) 多个 occurrence 且都无 instanceKey 时 needsInstanceKey=true；(3) controlId 是 DOM occurrence 追踪 ID（保留 R1 语义），仍含 hash(selector+variantId+...)，仅用于审计可重算与 DOM 追踪。R1.3 / A0 关键变更：needsActionKey / needsInstanceKey 是独立 boolean 字段，允许同时为真；mappingStatus 改为派生字段，取值 mapped / pending-action-key / pending-instance-key / pending-action-and-instance-key。来源：A0 · 全局控制面纠偏（基线 a6993b4）。

controlId.description: R1.2: DOM occurrence tracking id (NOT the logical identity). Pattern: domain.family.route.state.role[.discriminator]. Kept for audit reproducibility and DOM tracking; the logical identity lives in entityKey / controlKey.

entityKey.description: R1.2: Logical control entity identity (3+ atoms): {domain}.{family}.{role}[.{actionKey}]. actionKey is derived ONLY from the explicit semantic attribute whitelist (data-action / data-route / data-route-back / data-route-replace / data-demo-back); it never depends on selector / label / variantId / domTag / viewport / DOM order. When actionKey is null (no explicit semantic attribute), entityKey = {domain}.{family}.{role} and mappingStatus = pending-explicit-semantics.

controlKey.description: R1.2: Logical control occurrence in (route, state): {entityKey}@{route}.{state}[.{instanceKey}]. Viewport-independent. When instanceKey is non-null, it disambiguates multiple occurrences. When instanceKey is null and multiple occurrences exist, mappingStatus = pending-instance-disambiguation and an ordinal (n0, n1, ...) sorted by candidateKey is used as fallback.

actionKey.description: R1.2 / A1: Explicit semantic action key, derived ONLY from the whitelist: data-action (value is the actionKey), data-route (-> 'route.push'), data-route-replace (-> 'route.replace'), data-route-back (-> 'route.back'), data-demo-back (-> 'route.back'), data-settings-key (value is the actionKey, for settings subcontrols). null when no explicit semantic attribute is present; needsActionKey=true. Never inferred from label / text / class / selector / role.

instanceKey.description: R1.2: Explicit instance disambiguator, derived from instance identifier attributes (data-instance / data-book-id / data-reader-tts-timer-value / data-rss-source-id / etc.). null when no instance attribute is present. When multiple occurrences of the same (route, state, entityKey) all have null instanceKey, mappingStatus = pending-instance-disambiguation.

needsActionKey.description: A0 (schema 1.3.0): Independent boolean flag — true when actionKey is null (no explicit semantic attribute from the whitelist). Independent of needsInstanceKey; both can be true simultaneously. mappingStatus is derived from the (needsActionKey, needsInstanceKey) pair.

needsInstanceKey.description: A0 (schema 1.3.0): Independent boolean flag — true when the entry belongs to a multi-occurrence (route, state, entityKey) group with null instanceKey and ordinal fallback was applied. Independent of needsActionKey; both can be true simultaneously. mappingStatus is derived from the (needsActionKey, needsInstanceKey) pair.

family.description: Component family derived from DOM tag, ARIA role, and class hints; not bound to a specific Figma component set.

route.description: ScreenGraph routeId (kebab-case). 260 canonical routes are currently enumerated.

state.description: Variant pageState (kebab-case). Examples: default, loading, error, empty, offline, permission, conflict, result, preview.

viewport.description: Viewport instance for this registry entry. The logical controlId does not include viewport, so the same controlId can carry multiple viewport instances (phone / compact / tablet / fold).

role.description: Semantic role atom; matches the ARIA role or tag-derived role, kebab-cased. ARIA container roles (group/section) are excluded from the registry; they are recorded in nonInteractiveContainers.json when encountered.

discriminator.description: Stable disambiguator within (domain, family, route, state, role). Either a semantic slug derived from data attributes (e.g. top-action-search-h-1c0d0896) or a deterministic hash fragment (e.g. h-ab12cd34).

candidateKey.description: Deterministic IC0 audit candidate key; not canonical, but tracked for drift.

selectorSha256.description: SHA-256 of the audit DOM selector; ensures discriminator reproducibility.

domTag.description: Original DOM tag from the IC0 inventory record.

label.description: Accessible name resolved by the IC0 audit (may be empty for non-semantic candidates).

uiEvent.description: Canonical UiEvent hint resolved by the IC0 audit, if any.

dataAttributes.description: Sorted data-* attribute snapshot from the IC0 audit; never mutated.

mappingStatus.description: A0 (schema 1.3.0): Derived field. Computed from the independent (needsActionKey, needsInstanceKey) pair: (false,false)->mapped; (true,false)->pending-action-key; (false,true)->pending-instance-key; (true,true)->pending-action-and-instance-key. Read-only — callers MUST set needsActionKey / needsInstanceKey instead.

mappingNotes.description: Optional human-readable explanation of mapping decisions or unresolved ambiguities.

componentInstanceId.description: ScreenGraph component instance id, or null when no candidate instance matches.

componentType.description: ScreenGraph ComponentType name, or null when unresolved.

figmaNodeCandidate.description: Reserved for Figma node id backfill; always null in the R1 baseline because Figma has no canonical join key yet.

figmaJoinStatus.description: Figma join status; always 'pending-figma-join' in the R1 baseline.

nonInteractiveContainer.description: Optional marker; when true, the candidate was classified as a non-interactive ARIA container (group/section) and excluded from the canonical registry. Always null in the canonical registry; non-null only in nonInteractiveContainers.json records.
